title: Travel Chain
tagline: Making travel and vacation booking simple for crypto holders.
description:
Avoiding forex trade during travel trips is one fantastic use case of DeFi. We've used the same reason to create Travel Chain. A decentralized travel booking system that accepts only, and almost all cryptocurrencies as payment. 

You can create your travel itinerary without much technical hassle. Simply head over to the Book option from the navigation bar on the top right panel. Enter the details asked regarding your stay/ journey. Make sure you've connected your digital wallet and proceed with payment.

Every booking you make gets you closer to a reward. NFTs are rewarded after a certain number of bookings made by the user on the platform. These NFTs hold special values as they provide an extra (but limited) discount.

Special NFT holders also get token/ NFT drops, these users are whitelisted for future collaboration on projects. You could sell these NFTs on a marketplace. 

You could even mint your own NFTs by uploading pictures from your journey. These NFTs can be sold to users of the platform within the Travel Chain marketplace or a secondary NFT market. A resort owner or a generic user may use the NFTs without many technical difficulties. 

On your Dashboard, the User Info tells which level of NFTs they have and past transactions as well. My Collection is a glimpse of all NFTs owned and generated. A user can easily create NFTs by uploading photos from their travel trip from the Create NFT option on the Dashboard.

If a hotel is not found, a user or the Hotel Manager can upload the details of the hotel to the site through their account dashboard.
how_its_made:
I have enjoyed learning about many sponsors by attending their workshops. 
For my project, I have used IPFS for storage, World Coin for identifying the user, Unstoppable Domain & XMTP for messaging with customer care.

For each tech, I have done the best from my learning & support for the community.
